name: Deep dub sub riddim
desc: King Tubby-school melodic dub bassline in F# minor: a four-bar riddim that walks root, b7 and VI with wide rests, pure sine driven through shape for weight, filter blooming over 16 bars. Peak adds octave pops and a doubled turnaround.

code.full: note("<[f#1 ~ ~ f#1 ~ ~ e1 ~] [f#1 ~ ~ f#1 ~ a1 b1 ~] [f#1 ~ ~ f#1 ~ ~ e1 ~] [d1 ~ ~ d1 ~ e1 c#1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.01).decay(.35).sustain(.45).release(.25).shape(.5).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).gain(${gain}).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[f#1 f#2 ~ f#1 ~ ~ e1 e2] [f#1 f#2 ~ f#1 a1 ~ b1 ~] [f#1 f#2 ~ f#1 ~ ~ e1 e2] [d1 d2 ~ d1 e1 ~ c#1 c#2]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.008).decay(.3).sustain(.4).release(.2).shape(.55).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.6).slow(8)).gain(${gain}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
